name: Build images

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [v6]
    paths:
      - versions.json
      - scripts/image-matrix.sh
      - .github/workflows/build.yml
  push:
    branches: [dev, v6]
    paths:
      - versions.json
      - scripts/image-matrix.sh
      - .github/workflows/build.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

concurrency:
  group: build-images-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  PUBLISH_IMAGES: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/v6' && github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.matrix }}
      count: ${{ steps.matrix.outputs.count }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - id: matrix
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
        run: |
          old_versions=$(mktemp)
          if [ -n "${BASE_SHA:-}" ] && git show "$BASE_SHA:versions.json" > "$old_versions" 2>/dev/null; then
            :
          else
            printf '{"images":[]}\n' > "$old_versions"
          fi
          matrix=$(scripts/image-matrix.sh "$old_versions" versions.json)
          echo "matrix=$matrix" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "count=$(jq '.include | length' <<< "$matrix")" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  build:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.count != '0'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.prepare.outputs.matrix) }}
    name: ${{ matrix.name }}:${{ matrix.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@v4

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v4

      - name: Set release image tag
        env:
          SERVICE: ${{ matrix.target }}
          IMAGE: xtrime/${{ matrix.repository }}:${{ matrix.version }}
        run: |
          printf 'services:\n  %s:\n    image: %s\n' "$SERVICE" "$IMAGE" > "${{ matrix.source }}/release-compose.yml"

      - uses: docker/login-action@v4
        if: env.PUBLISH_IMAGES == 'true'
        with:
          username: xtrime
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_TOKEN }}

      - uses: docker/login-action@v4
        if: env.PUBLISH_IMAGES == 'true'
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - uses: docker/bake-action@v7
        with:
          source: ./${{ matrix.source }}
          files: |
            ${{ matrix.compose }}
            release-compose.yml
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}
          set: |
            ${{ matrix.set_tags }}
            ${{ matrix.target }}.cache-from=type=gha,scope=${{ matrix.name }}
            ${{ matrix.target }}.cache-to=type=gha,mode=max,scope=${{ matrix.name }}
          push: ${{ env.PUBLISH_IMAGES == 'true' }}
